decisions.text: colours fixed by name, the same in every chart of the set (colours.slots, the registry ../registry.json): Elstead Park slot 2, Brackley Hill slot 1, Corwen Road slot 3, Dunmore slot 4 (G4.22)

arranged: columns by Category, series in each panel by Centre: the insight compares store directly (facts.compare): drawn as series in each panel (RP3-4, G1.19); the panels facet on category; runner-up for review: rows by Category, columns by Centre (D-38 (i))

each series its own colour, the same in every panel, fixed, the same in every chart of the set (R3-24, G4.22): Brackley Hill slot 1, Dunmore slot 4, Corwen Road slot 3, Elstead Park slot 2 (G4.27, G7.50)
type line: a regular series whose pattern of change is the point (06 DP6-1, G1.51)
one shared scale: one scale for every panel, so that sizes compare across panels (G7.48)
values on both sides of zero: room at both ends
scale −50–20 by 10
the title wraps onto two lines
dates marked on the time axis: a thin line at the date in every panel, its label once (G7.49): “New store opens” in 3 panels, labelled once, in Furniture & BBQs
no point markers: no value is isolated and no straight run hides one
highlighted, twice as thick, in the strong shade of its hue, its label bold: Elstead Park; the others keep their colours and widths
the unit phrase on the top label: “+20% on 2025”; the top gridline starts after it
time axis: row 1 narrow
time axis: row 2 (“2026”) left out, the title gives it (G2.37)
dates marked on the time axis, each a thin dark-grey line across the plot under the marks, its label the chart's own note beside it: Mar. 1, 2026, “New store opens”, labelled right of its top
each line labelled at its end, in the text grey, none moved
1 × 3 panels of equal size, abutting, divided by light separators, no box round a panel (G7.51); each 168 pt wide and 252 pt high
scale labels left of the first column, the unit phrase once on the first row's top label; time labels only under the bottom row; column headers above the top row (G7.49)
each series labelled once, at its line's end right of the last panel (G5.15, D-38 (iii))

source.shows: small multiples of one set of charts (eval round 1, B11, chart 2): each centre keeps the colour the document's registry gives it (examples/registry.json, colours.registry) in this chart and in r1-65, whatever the order of the line ends; the competitor's opening, March 2026, marked in every panel and labelled once; clash: two centres given one slot, the second takes a free slot, with a warning
